q: What separates a useful estimate from a guess?
options: Stated assumptions that others can check and correct

q: About how many requests per second is 1 million requests a day on average?
Why multiply by calls per task for agents?
options: One user request can trigger dozens of model calls with growing contexts

q: Why size capacity for peaks rather than averages?
options: Users wait when peak demand exceeds capacity
explain: Peak factors of 2 to 5 are common.
